newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Zedillo honors top 1996 exporters.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zedillo honors top 1996 exporters.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo awarded National Export Awards for 1996 to companies and institutions he said distinguished themselves for their initiative in foreign trade.

Celanese Mexicana, a producer of synthetic fiber, basic chemicals and packing materials, received the award in the large company category. In the past four years the subsidiary of chemicals giant Hoechst AG invested $500 million and has 200 national suppliers.
For medium-sized businesses, the prize went to Segusino Rustic Furniture, a company which exports to 41 countries.
Micro, a synthetic rubber producer, received the award for small businesses.

"The award ... gives testimony to the efforts made by the country's different productive sectors to achieve levels of excellence in exporting activity," Deputy Trade Minister Decio de Maria said at the award ceremony.
The award winners were chosen from among 294 companies.

Organic Producers of Cabo was awarded the prize in the category of agricultural, forestry and fishing companies, while Urological Products of Mexico won among the maquiladoras and Compania Cosmo won among wholesalers.
